verses.gurmukhi: ਬਾਛੈ ਨ ਸ੍ਵਰਗ ਬਾਸ ਮਾਨੈ ਨ ਨਰਕ ਤ੍ਰਾਸ ਆਸਾ ਨ ਕਰਤ ਚਿਤ ਹੋਨਹਾਰ ਹੋਇ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: baachhai na savairag baas maanai na narak traas aasaa na karat chit honahaar hoi hai ||

en.bdb: An obedient disciple of the True Guru neither asks for heaven nor does he fear hell. He does not keep any longing or desire in his mind. Instead he believes that whatever God does is just right.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸੰਪਤਿ ਨ ਹਰਖ ਬਿਪਤ ਮੈ ਨ ਸੋਗ ਤਾਹਿ ਸੁਖ ਦੁਖ ਸਮਸਰਿ ਬਿਹਸ ਨ ਰੋਇ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: sa(n)pat na harakh bipat mai na sog taeh sukh dhukh samasar bihas na roi hai ||

en.bdb: Acquisition of wealth does not make him happy. In the times of distress, he is never morose. Instead he treats distresses and comforts alike and does not lament or rejoice on them.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਜਵਿਨ ਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਭੇਦ ਖੇਦ ਗੰਮਿਤਾ ਤ੍ਰਿਕਾਲ ਬਾਲ ਬੁਧਿ ਅਵਿਲੋਇ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: janam javin mirat mukat na bhedh khedh ga(n)mitaa tirakaal baal budh aviloi hai ||

en.bdb: He is not afraid of birth and death and has no desire of salvation. He is least affected by the worldly dualities and remain in a state of equipoise. He is aware of all the three periods of life and know all the happenings of the world. Yet he always looks like an innocent child.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗਿਆਨ ਗੁਰ ਅੰਜਨ ਕੈ ਚੀਨਤ ਨਿਰੰਜਨਹਿ ਬਿਰਲੋ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਮੈ ਕੋਇ ਹੈ ॥੪੦੯॥
verses.translit_en: giaan gur a(n)jan kai cheenat nira(n)janeh biralo sa(n)saar prem bhagat mai koi hai ||409||

en.bdb: Who ever is blessed with the collyrium of knowledge of the True Guru, recognises the mammon-free Lord God. But such a person who is able to achieve that state is rare in the world.  (409)
